Transcription of the 1829 Hospital parish (Cashel & Emly diocese, Co. Limerick) baptism register, two-page spread covering late Feb through early April 1829. The register follows the formula: day of month, "Bap." (Baptized), child's name, parents' names ("of [Father] & [Mother]"), and sponsors/godparents ("Sp. [Sponsor 1] & [Sponsor 2]").

**Our family's entry is at the top of Page 71 (right page):**
> 20th Bap. Patrick of James Gleeson & Honora O Brien — Sp. Stephen Gleeson & Bridget Higgins

This page was previously cited as "Page 55" — that was a misread of "Page 71" (pages 70+71 are the natural facing-page pair in a bound register; 5/7 is a common cursive confusion).

Source image: `assets/external/ancestry/hospital.png`.
